name: Tab Tweaks
description: Right-click the new tab button to open the clipboard in a new tab; double-click any tab to close it; in the collapsed sidebar, hovering a tab slides its title out beside it in the tab's own style (split views and folders slide out whole); press and hold the reload button for normal reload, hard reload, or empty cache and hard reload. Each can be turned on or off in the mod settings.
author: dvgmdvgm

JS/clipboard-newtab.uc.js.name: Tab Clicks
JS/clipboard-newtab.uc.js.description: Clipboard new tab on right-click, close tab on double-click.

JS/tab-peek.uc.js.name: Tab Peek
JS/tab-peek.uc.js.description: Slides the hovered tab title out in the collapsed sidebar, styled like the tab.

JS/reload-menu.uc.js.name: Reload Menu
JS/reload-menu.uc.js.description: Press and hold the reload button: normal reload, hard reload, empty cache and hard reload.
